$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFTN (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Grand'Combe

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for home-based ACFT and ACFT based on the neighbouring AD (1).
Pilots with a mountain licence can also use the AD.
If wind stronger than 10 m/s, possible turbulences on final.
If East wind, heavy down-draft on South THR.
Presence of a 2090 ft hill, North-East of RWY, covered by woods penetrating the side clearance surface.
Preferred QFU: 346°, due to heavy down-draft with North wind.
Turn left as soon as possible after TKOF.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
QFU 346°: cause of movable nature of the North-East part of runway, preferably use West part during bad weather.
AEM (NR 9537): See AIP ENR 5.5 Use of either AEM areas depending on MET conditions.
Users permanently monitoring FREQ (1) AD voisins / Neighbouring AD: AIX - ALES - AUBENAS - AVIGNON - LANGOGNE - MENDE - MONTELIMAR -
AD réservé aux ACFT basés et à ceux basés sur les AD voisins (1).
Les pilotes titulaires de la qualification "Montagne" peuvent également se poser sur l'AD.
Par vent supérieur à 10 m/s, risque de turbulence en finale.
Présence d'une colline culminant à 2090 ft au Nord-Est de la piste, recouverte d'un bois perçant la surface latérale de dégagement.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
QFU 346° : cause caractère meuble de la partie NordEst de la piste, utiliser de préférence la partie Ouest en période d'intempéries.
Activités particulières AEM (N° 9537) : Voir AIP ENR 5.5 Utilisation de l'une ou l'autre des zones AEM en fonction des conditions MTO.
